I was raised learning how to make something out of nothing—growing food, caring for animals, and preserving what we had. Today, I carry those same values into everything I do. We raise chickens and ducks, grow seasonal produce, and create handmade pantry goods like baked items, preserves, and natural fertilizer products using what we produce right here on our land. Everything is made in compliance with Alabama cottage food laws and operates under a registered LLC, so while it’s rooted in old-fashioned ways, it’s built to grow and serve our community the right way.
